name: zju-research-skills
description: A traceable Research OS that plans and executes evidence-grounded workflows for Zhejiang University researchers.

interface.shortDescription: A gated, traceable research operating system for ZJU.
interface.longDescription: Twenty evidence-grounded skills with one Research Director coordinating literature discovery and monitoring, lawful full-text access, reading and synthesis, hypothesis design, experiment logging, statistics, writing, figures, presentations, review and response, data sharing, proposals, patents, chemistry databases, and research integrity through a shared mission protocol.
defaultPrompt: 把这个研究目标规划成可执行、可追溯的跨阶段 Research Mission。
继续这个科研项目，检查闸门后执行下一个可运行阶段。
审计这项研究从证据、实验到投稿的完整性与复现性。
